_comment: Statements the published documents make about what the product really does. The site owner confirms each relevant claim (Legal::confirmedClaims); an unconfirmed claim is reported by `legal/check`. 'when' is a feature flag key; empty = always relevant.

claims.text: A cookie-settings link is available in the footer of every page and lets visitors change or withdraw their choice at any time.
Non-essential (analytics) cookies are not set before consent, and refusing is as easy as accepting.
Advertising cookies and identifiers are not set before consent.
Global Privacy Control and similar browser opt-out signals are treated as a refusal of non-essential tracking.
Users can delete their account and personal data themselves in the account settings.
The mobile app has an in-app account deletion path (Settings, Account, Delete account).
Privacy requests sent to the privacy/contact mailbox are acknowledged within 72 hours and answered within one month.
The contact, privacy and legal mailboxes shown in the documents exist and are monitored.
A procedure exists to notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours and affected users without undue delay after a personal-data breach.
Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and sensitive data at rest.
Multi-factor authentication is offered to users where stated, and used for administrative access.
Customers can export their content for 30 days after closing their account.
Subscriptions can be cancelled in the account settings and users are told before renewal or a price change.
At checkout consumers are asked for express consent and acknowledgement before digital content or services start immediately.
Refund and withdrawal requests sent to the contact mailbox are answered within 5 business days.
Enforcement decisions state the reason and can be appealed by email within 6 months, with human review.
The legal/abuse mailbox receives copyright and illegal-content notices and they are reviewed promptly.
Business customers are notified of a personal-data breach within the configured number of hours.
The technical and organisational measures in Annex II (access control, MFA for admin access, encrypted backups, logging, incident response) are really in place.
The sub-processor list is accurate and customers are told before a change.
Vulnerability reports are acknowledged within 3 business days.
Purchase limits or parental controls exist, and the odds of random rewards are shown before purchase.
At least 60 days' notice is given before the game or paid service ends.
Guardian consent is collected for users below the age of majority, and guardians can review or delete the minor's data.
No session-replay, screen-recording, keystroke-capture or fingerprinting tools are loaded anywhere (including error-monitoring add-ons that offer replay).

Every read, write, download and export is checked on the server against the owner and the people the owner gave access to; users cannot reach other accounts' or organisations' data by changing an id or a link.
No secret keys, tokens or service credentials are present in browser code, HTML, mobile apps or public repositories; only keys designed to be public are used on the client.
Uploaded files are private by default, served only after an access check, and never used in public templates, guidelines, marketing or training material unless the owner publishes them.
Resources that receive the visitor's IP address (fonts, maps, video, captcha...) are loaded only after the visitor agrees to each one, and the list in data.external is complete.
The age and legal-age confirmation is shown before age-sensitive features, is not pre-ticked, is recorded, and users who do not confirm are blocked.

Every email contains a link to stop emails; optional emails stop with one click and immediately; a request to block all email is confirmed by a link in a last email and then added to the sender's no-send list.
Consents and choices are recorded per account with the version, date and language, and users are asked again when a required consent changes.

Next to the payment button: price, billing period, automatic renewal, what follows a trial, how to cancel and links to Terms, Refunds and Privacy; consent is an unchecked box or button; the record is kept at least three years.
Yearly plans get a reminder 15 to 45 days before renewal and an annual reminder; users are told before a trial converts to a paid plan; cancelling works with a direct button online.
Consumers can withdraw from a contract with a labelled function in the account and order confirmation, with confirmation and a durable-medium acknowledgement.
The DMCA designated agent shown is registered in the US Copyright Office directory and is renewed every three years.
